starts.how: Find Barbas while looking for Lod's dog and talk to him; he asks for your help. If you put him off, he waits for you outside Haemar's Shame.

takesYou.why: the shrine of Clavicus Vile inside, where Vile agrees to take Barbas back for the Rueful Axe
retrieve the Rueful Axe with Barbas; the wizard Sebastian Lort is there
bring the Rueful Axe and Barbas back to the shrine

choices.choice: Give the Rueful Axe to Clavicus Vile
choices.leadsTo: Barbas and Clavicus Vile are reunited and you receive the Masque of Clavicus Vile

choices.choice: Kill Barbas with the Rueful Axe
choices.leadsTo: Barbas dies and you keep the Rueful Axe

objectives: Travel with Barbas to the shrine of Clavicus Vile
Retrieve the Rueful Axe with Barbas
Return to the shrine of Clavicus Vile with Barbas and the Rueful Axe
Give the Rueful Axe to Clavicus Vile OR kill Barbas with the Rueful Axe

rewards.when: if you give the Rueful Axe to Clavicus Vile
if you kill Barbas with it and keep it

closes: Barbas dies, if you kill him with the Rueful Axe
You give up either the Rueful Axe or the Masque of Clavicus Vile: you can't get both

people.name: Barbas
people.role: Clavicus Vile's talking dog; travels with you

people.name: Clavicus Vile
people.role: Daedric Prince, speaks through his shrine in Haemar's Shame

people.name: Sebastian Lort
people.role: wizard leader in Rimerock Burrow, where the Rueful Axe is

unsure.why: Barbas's offer line has no conditions in these files; whether you can meet him without first hearing about Lod's dog isn't shown. His placement is inside Haemar's Shame, and the quest moves him to a meeting marker on the road.
Wintersun - Faiths of Skyrim edits this quest last; what it changed (for example anything tied to worship) isn't shown in these files.
The places index lists Haemar's Shame under Falkreath hold (nearest settlement Ivarstead) and Rimerock Burrow under Haafingar, near Dragon Bridge.
